title: Goodnight, Moon and Stars | Kids Song & Nursery Rhymes for Bedtime | BuBu TV - English
description:
A soft bedtime song about pyjamas, a bright moon and a wise little owl.
It shows how cosy routines and sleepy goodnights help us drift off to sweet dreams.
Sing along with your little ones to calm the evening and say goodnight to the moon and stars!

Close your eyes, sleep so tight
Goodnight moon, goodnight stars
Snore, snore, snore, snore
Sweet dreams, sweet dreams, goodnight!

Pillow fight, bop, bop, bop!
Feathers fly up high, whee, whee
Hoo hoo, hoo hoo, hoo hoo
"Oh no, it's sleep time, see!"

The owl says, "Stars are sleepy too"
Yawn, yawn, yawn, yawn
Blink, blink, blink, blink
Shh, shh, shh, goodnight to you!

Everyone sleeps, snug and warm
The owl closes one eye, wink, wink
Night, night, night, night
Soft night, soft night!
